selection.rationale: Measured facts: the accepted chunked-stem bundle (trial-80e1dd9d82-param-2d5ce665, stem_micro_batch=4) is installed in the current revision and the current trace confirms it executes (stem conv/bn/relu/max_pool each count=8 on [4,3,224,224]/[4,64,112,112], 8 slices, cat of 8x[4,64,56,56]); the independently measured project objective moved 282,103,808 -> 205,033,472 B (paired AB/BA, noise bounds 0, quality max_abs_error 0.0, images_per_second 6921-7328 vs limit 6592.52). Parameter search shows stem_micro_batch 4 and 8 both measure exactly 205,033,472 B while their stem scratch windows differ (2x12,845,056 vs 2x25,690,112 B conv/bn pairs plus different slice accumulations), so the global peak no longer sits in the stem: it sits in the execution window common to both configurations, the un-chunked encoder, whose largest activations are the stage-0 [32,64,56,56] tensors (25,690,112 B each, 3 concurrent per ResNetConvLayer conv->out-of-place BN->out-of-place ReLU plus in-place add_ residual) on top of the fixed 66,025,632 B floor (46,758,048 B fp32 parameters + 19,267,584 B batch input); micro=16 measures 246,714,368 B, confirming the stem window scales with chunk size and only exceeds the encoder window at large chunks. resources.json states per-operator allocator attribution is unavailable, so the ~62 MB gap between signature arithmetic (~143 MB) and the measured 205,033,472 B stays unattributed (most plausibly conv workspace that also scales with batch); this is a hypothesis to be tested, not a claim. The reducible transient above the fixed floor is 139,007,840 B. The selected region is the complete ResNetModel subtree (call fb7277dba44d770ed1cbb22f: embeddings, encoder, pooler, and every nested module/aten site), which is the smallest coherent editable boundary that contains both the measured encoder peak window and the stem-side full-batch intermediates the current design still materializes (the [32,64,56,56] cat output 25,690,112 B plus 8 accumulated [4,64,56,56] slices 25,690,112 B). It composes with the inherited stem bundle rather than re-editing it: a replacement at the ResNetModel boundary invokes the embeddings boundary via context.references per micro-batch, so the inherited required call fa7ef6548e3a2d54174caeba stays covered under the legacy binding backend, and the classifier head outside the region keeps its unchanged [32,512,1,1]/[32,512] inputs. No selected group mixes calls outside this subtree (verified against calls.json), no communication collectives exist (single-device, world_size 1), and profiler record-function hooks are excluded following the accepted precedent.
selection.hypothesis: Replace the ResNetModel forward inside this region with micro-batched execution of the whole visual stack: slice pixel_values along dim 0 into chunks of encoder_micro_batch samples (default 8, tunable {8,4,16}), pass each chunk through the unchanged embeddings, encoder and pooler callables obtained from context.references (the installed stem replacement first, whose guard composes: chunk 8 > stem micro 4 re-chunks, chunk 4 takes the parent path on a 4-sample batch - identical per-sample math either way), and join the per-chunk [m,512,7,7] last_hidden_state and [m,512,1,1] pooler outputs with one cat each, returning the same BaseModelOutputWithPoolingAndNoAttention the parent returns. All ops in the region are per-sample exact under inference_mode with eval-mode BatchNorm running statistics (training=false observed in every aten::batch_norm signature) - precedent: the accepted stem candidate measured logits max_abs_error 0.0 at chunk sizes 4/8/16. Peak hypothesis: the encoder stage-0 window that currently sets 205,033,472 B scales to roughly fixed 66,025,632 B + 139,007,840 x (m/32) B of activation/scratch, and the full-batch [32,64,56,56] intermediate pair (cat input plus accumulated slices, 2x25,690,112 B) disappears because chunks flow stem->encoder->pooler without reassembly; the new global peak becomes the per-chunk stem conv/bn pair (2x25,690,112 B at m=8, 2x12,845,056 B at m=4) plus small accumulated [m,512,7,7] outputs, i.e. an expected peak near 1.3-1.55e8 B at m=8 and 1.05-1.35e8 B at m=4 (25-49% below the current accepted 205,033,472 B), still far above the parameter floor. Constraint check: images_per_second must stay >= 6592.52 (latency <= 4.855 ms vs current 4.35-4.61 ms); micro-batching roughly triples small-kernel launches at m=8, but the accepted stem candidate already measured 4.349 ms with 8 chunks, so the budget is expected to hold; chunk count stays a tunable parameter so measurement, not this estimate, decides. Risks to be tested by the paired evaluation: conv workspace may not scale linearly with chunk size (micro=16 measured 246,714,368 B, above naive activation arithmetic - smaller m hedges this), exact_top1 must be re-confirmed for chunked 3x3/1x1 encoder convolutions, and if any guard rejects the observed signature the replacement must fall back to the parent forward (correct output, no memory win).

proposal.rationale: Measured facts from inputs/previous-feedback.txt: the chunked-stem bundle trial-80e1dd9d82-param-2d5ce665 (stem_micro_batch=4) was accepted (decision state evaluated, quality pass with logits max_abs_error 0.0, coverage counts fa7ef6548e3a2d54174caeba=2 with route stem_microbatch, no candidate_diagnostics events, no rejected trial to repair) and is installed in the current revision e4ada302...; the independently measured project objective is 205,033,472 B (paired AB/BA vs 282,103,808 B baseline, noise bounds 0, images_per_second 6921-7328 against the 6592.52 limit). Parameter search shows stem_micro_batch 4 and 8 both measure exactly 205,033,472 B while their stem scratch windows differ, so the global peak now sits in the window common to both, the un-chunked encoder, whose stage-0 [32,64,56,56] activations (25,690,112 B each, ~3 concurrent per ResNetConvLayer conv -> out-of-place BN -> out-of-place ReLU plus the in-place add_ residual) sit on the fixed 66,025,632 B floor (46,758,048 B fp32 parameters + 19,267,584 B batch input); the current design also still materializes the full-batch [32,64,56,56] stem cat output plus 8 accumulated [4,64,56,56] slices (2x25,690,112 B). How the feedback changes this attempt: there is no failed candidate to repair, so this candidate extends the accepted approach one boundary up instead - it replaces only the region head fb7277dba44d770ed1cbb22f (model.resnet, ResNetModel) with micro-batched execution of the whole visual stack: pixel_values is sliced along dim 0 into chunks of encoder_micro_batch samples (default 8, tunable {8,4,16}, independent of the frozen batch of 32; every chunk executes on every invocation), each chunk flows embedder -> encoder -> pooler through the unchanged callables obtained from context.references (the installed stem replacement first: at chunk 8 its guard re-chunks into two 4-slices, at chunk 4 it takes its parent path - identical per-sample math either way, exactly the composition the accepted bundle measured at max_abs_error 0.0), and the per-chunk [m,512,7,7] last_hidden_state and [m,512,1,1] pooler outputs are joined with one torch.cat each, returning the same BaseModelOutputWithPoolingAndNoAttention (return_dict=True, hidden_states=None as observed; kwargs resolution mirrors the parent via the module config defaults output_hidden_states=False, return_dict=True). The classifier head outside the region receives the same [32,512,1,1] pooler_output, so logits/top1 semantics are unchanged. Composition and coverage: the inherited required call fa7ef6548e3a2d54174caeba stays covered because the replacement invokes the embeddings boundary through context.references once per chunk (4 calls at m=8, 8 at m=4, 2 at m=16, all >= 1), and encoder/pooler references likewise execute per chunk, so no observed call is eliminated and all work contributes to the returned output; no CUDA Graph is used, so Python hooks and reference counters observe real invocations and no graph-pool accounting ambiguity applies. CPU corroboration on the real fixture with the dev-venv python (allowed inspection, no GPU): the composed chunked path (stem micro 4 -> encoder micro 4/8/16) reproduces the parent last_hidden_state/pooler_output within 4.3e-06 max abs on logits (gate atol=rtol=1e-4) with exact top1 at all three chunk sizes, and a CPU-signature call takes the labeled parent fallback with bitwise-equal output. Peak hypothesis to be tested by the paired evaluation, not claimed: the encoder window scales to roughly fixed floor + reducible transient x (m/32), the full-batch stem reassembly pair disappears, and the new global peak becomes the per-chunk stem conv/bn pair plus small accumulated [m,512,7,7] parts, i.e. an expected peak near 1.3-1.55e8 B at m=8 and 1.05-1.35e8 B at m=4; conv workspace scaling below m=16 is unknown (micro=16 measured 246,714,368 B, above naive activation arithmetic), which smaller m hedges. Throughput: images_per_second must stay >= 6592.52 (latency <= 4.855 ms vs current 4.35-4.61 ms); chunking adds launches (the accepted stem candidate already ran 8 chunks in 4.349 ms), and the tunable parameter lets measurement decide the memory/throughput point. Route labels are reported via context['record_route'] inside the replacement: 'model_microbatch' on the chunked path, 'fallback_parent_signature' when the guard rejects the call (non-tensor/non-fp32/non-CUDA/non-contiguous/requires_grad input, unexpected kwargs, ambiguous pixel_values passing, batch <= micro, channel mismatch, resolved output_hidden_states=True or return_dict=False, grad enabled, training mode), 'fallback_parent_runtime' when a RuntimeError/ValueError aborts the chunk loop (stateless eval ops leave no partial state, so parent recomputation is exact); an unresolvable reference/module/import at build time returns an empty mapping (concise setup failure, parent keeps running). No bundle write overlaps this candidate's call (the installed stem bundle writes call fa7ef6548e3a2d54174caeba), so requires records the composition dependency and replaces stays empty.
proposal.setup_work: Build-time work is pure CPU resolution: import BaseModelOutputWithPoolingAndNoAttention, look up four parent references (ResNetModel fb7277dba44d770ed1cbb22f, embedder fa7ef6548e3a2d54174caeba, encoder 5784db785cf33b978d46d02b, pooler 764b049d6a49f5ecc2002175) and two physical modules from context, read embedder.num_channels and the ResNetModel config's output_hidden_states/return_dict defaults, and clamp the optional encoder_micro_batch parameter to {4, 8, 16} (default 8). No weight packing, no parameter transforms, no persistent buffers, no CUDA allocation, no fixture-dependent precomputation; setup allocation is 0 B and nothing is retained between invocations (the returned closure holds only Python references). State lifecycle: the workload is stateless inference; the replacement consumes no RNG, mutates no module state, and adds no synchronization beyond the parent's own ops, so adapter.reset/run semantics and the frozen peak-stat boundary are untouched. Per invocation the chunked path allocates only transient scratch: per chunk the stem replacement's window (at the installed stem_micro_batch=4: two concurrent [4,64,112,112] tensors = 2x12,845,056 B plus slice accumulation and one [m,64,56,56] cat), encoder activations at chunk scale ([8,64,56,56] = 6,422,528 B scale, ~3 concurrent at stage 0), the accumulated per-chunk [m,512,7,7] parts (4x802,816 B at m=8) and [m,512,1,1] parts, and the final cat outputs [32,512,7,7] = 3,211,264 B and [32,512,1,1] = 65,536 B - all freed with the forward. No CUDA Graph capture is used, so no allocation moves into graph pools and framework.peak_allocated_bytes keeps its per-run meaning; the optimized quantity is the declared per-run peak_allocated_bytes counter, not a general physical-memory saving.
quality_risks: cudnn may select different convolution algorithms for chunk shapes (m in {4,8,16} for encoder 3x3/1x1 convs and nested 4-slices for the stem) than for the full batch 32, changing fp32 accumulation order; CPU corroboration measured logits max abs 4.3e-06 (micro=4) and 0.0 (micro=8/16) against the gate atol=rtol=1e-4, and the accepted stem bundle measured max_abs_error 0.0 on GPU at all three chunk sizes, but exact_top1 could still flip if the reference top-two logits were separated by less than the perturbation scale; the framework's paired quality run decides.

Throughput headroom: whole-model chunking multiplies small-kernel launches (4 chunks at m=8, 8 at m=4 re-running the encoder per chunk) against the ~4.855 ms budget (current 4.35-4.61 ms); micro=16 halves chunk count at a higher memory point. encoder_micro_batch is exposed as a tunable parameter so the frozen TaskSearch/TPE loop measures the tradeoff on the complete project.

The chunked path relies on per-sample-exact eval semantics: eval-mode BatchNorm running statistics (training=false in every observed aten::batch_norm signature), per-sample conv/relu/maxpool/adaptive-avgpool, and torch.inference_mode; the guard falls back to the labeled parent path whenever gradients are enabled, any module is in training mode, output_hidden_states resolves true, return_dict resolves false, or the signature/shape/dtype/device/contiguity checks fail, trading the memory win for exact parent behavior.

Composition depends on context.references returning the installed stem replacement for the embeddings boundary; if the stem bundle were absent the replacement still runs correctly through the parent embedder (higher stem window, still correct), and requires records the intended composition ordering.

If a runtime error aborts the chunk loop mid-way, the replacement re-runs the parent forward (labeled fallback_parent_runtime); ops are stateless under inference_mode so the recomputation is exact, at the cost of one wasted partial pass.

params.name: encoder_micro_batch
params.description: Samples per chunk in the ResNetModel replacement: pixel_values is sliced along dim 0 into chunks of this many samples, each flowing embedder->encoder->pooler through context.references before one cat per output. 8 is the default; 4 minimizes activation/workspace scale at more launches; 16 trades a higher per-chunk window for fewer launches. Does not alter the frozen batch of 32; all chunks execute on every invocation.
